Table Capture.title: Table Capture
reviews: This is a fantastic extension that really helps me set up extracting data from client sites that I don't have the best access to. It's helped me with tons of projects.

I needed to export my contact list from a previous phone provider that did not allow the feature. I used the app and worked as needed. Had a few questions along the way and George was extremely helpful and walked me through it. Even jumped on a quick Zoom call with me.  Awesome guy and great service. Highly recommend it.

I’ve tried every extension on the market, and TableCapture is easily the cleanest. Using it daily for a long time, and it remains consistent across all browsers, including Chrome, Firefox, and Opera. The developer, George is also accessible at any time and responds my emails quickly.
Wasted my time.  Makes you pay for any decent sized download.  Look elsewhere.

LOVE this extension! Make super easy Google sheets conversions of tables from a marketplace based website that doesn't have the functionality natively built in. This is going to help me as a food pantry manager better manage our inventory and procurement! George was incredibly responsive when I submitted a help ticket and hopped on a quick video call to walk through it with me. Highly recommend!

The product and support were amazing! Gemini kept giving me unhelpful information about how to get an online table into Numbers. I reached out to George Mike who helped me navigate through the product in 5 minutes. I got a database of close to 3000 native species.

reviews: No instructions and doesn't work.

Great app, I know a lot of people are frustrated with how this doesn't work but it totally does if you follow the instructions. If you know how to use this app, its great! 5 stars for all the different customization options!!

parses well but doesn't work on pdf documents or google docs properly; you'd have to highlight the entire text on the doc and click on the extension; but even then it doesn't detect separate paragraphs so the text is formatted on one huge paragraph.

For those who say it's not working: click on the puzzle piece icon on the top right of the window, this will list your extensions, then click on "Bionic Reading", you will see the page load for a moment before it turns bionic!
You must repeat this process for every page you want to turn bionic

For everyone who sees this, leave a five star rating with the same instructions above so the ratings can stop tanking on such a wonderful tool :)
